$comment: findings.json: the only file of a pass you write (references/filing.md). Keys starting with $ are comments; unknown keys and wrong types are errors (a line number is a number, never "12"). Never write ids, ranks, meta, the state matrix, the pixel diff or the scorecard.

pass.$comment: Optional: only what the evidence cannot tell (references/report.md).
